name: kujo-skills-launch-gate
command:
skill_count=$(find skills -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name SKILL.md | wc -l | tr -d ' ') && test "$skill_count" = 53 && test "$(cat VERSION)" = 0.1.0 && test -f LICENSE && test -f CHANGELOG.md && test -f SECURITY.md && test -f skills/kujo-workcell-workflows/SKILL.md && test -f skills/kujo-site-kit-workflows/SKILL.md && test -f skills/kujo-tribunal-workflows/SKILL.md && test -f skills/kujo-relay-workflows/SKILL.md && test -f skills/kujo-redact-workflows/SKILL.md && mkdir -p /tmp/agent-profile/skills && cp -R skills/kujo-core-language /tmp/agent-profile/skills/ && test -f /tmp/agent-profile/skills/kujo-core-language/SKILL.md && grep -Fq 'name: kujo-core-language' /tmp/agent-profile/skills/kujo-core-language/SKILL.md && printf 'version=0.1.0
skills=%s
required=workcell,site-kit,tribunal,relay,redact
install=kujo-core-language
' "$skill_count" > kujo-skills-workcell-proof.txt
